Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: w0rxbend
Message:
feat(telegram): durable inbox and webhook endpoint (G1.7)

Every update from long polling or the webhook is stored in inbound_inbox
(V3) before the poll offset moves or 200 is answered. The inbox processor
applies each chat's updates in update_id order through the mediator's new
pushAndWait and marks a row processed only after the event committed, so
a restart applies a stored update exactly once (TG-03, TG-04, TG-08); the
third failure quarantines an update (TG-09).

POST /tg/webhook/{path_secret} is mounted on the HTTP edge when
TELEGRAM_UPDATES_MODE=webhook: the path and header secrets are checked
in constant time before the body is read (404), the body is limited to
1 MiB, and start-up registers the webhook with setWebhook. The allowlist
applies at receipt: a stranger's update stores nothing. The stored body
is the minimal decoded update, without names. The worker half deletes
bodies after 24 hours and inbox and inbound_events rows after 7 days.
Long polling stays the default and goes through the same inbox.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: w0rxbend
Message:
feat(app): serve the Mini App and its API on one origin behind MINIAPP_ENABLED

ROADMAP G1.12 (the switch) and G3.3 (same-origin serving, headers, policy).

Settings: ENVIRONMENT (development, test, production; default production),
HTTP_PORT (default 8081), MINIAPP_ENABLED (default false),
MINIAPP_STATIC_DIR, TELEGRAM_BOT_ID, MINIAPP_INITDATA_PUBLIC_KEY and
MINIAPP_HMAC_FALLBACK. Start-up refuses MINIAPP_ENABLED=true in production
(checkpoint CP3-a), an enabled Mini App with nothing to verify launch data
with, the HMAC fallback without the bot token, and another Ed25519 key in
production (ARCHITECTURE CFG-01). .env.example is regenerated.

MiniAppEdge: with the switch on, the gateway half opens a second listener
for /app/ and /api/v1/; /healthz stays on its own port, and with the switch
off no listener exists. The application sets the header set of research
brief 06 section 12.4 on every answer of that origin, a 404 included:
content security policy, HSTS, nosniff, no-referrer, the deny-all
permissions policy and same-origin resource policy; no-store on every /api/
answer; no CORS header, no X-Frame-Options, no Server header. Requests are
not logged, because a path can hold a record id. The HMAC key is derived
from the bot token here, so the api module never receives the token (DEP-05).
A fork deletes expired sessions and old idempotency records every minute.

StaticApp: the built Mini App is read into memory at start-up, so a request
can only name a file that was in the directory. index.html is no-store,
files under assets/ are immutable, a path without an extension answers the
shell (MA-HOST-4), source maps are not served.

Tests: MiniAppSettingsSuite 9 in infra; MiniAppEdgeSuite 10 in app through
Launch.start on Testcontainers Postgres: the switch, the full header set on
ten kinds of answer, cache rules, the history fallback, four path-traversal
attempts, a session opened with launch data signed for the configured token
and one signed with another.

Standard gate green: 1120 tests (app 27, infra 152, api 88, contracts 89,
core 738, adapter-console 19, tests.conformance 6, tests.simulation 1).
